newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Plock refinery sees no shutdown this year.
newsitem.headline: Polish Plock refinery sees no shutdown this year.

text.p: Poland's largest oil refinery Rafineria Plocka SA plans to keep its production going while it modernises its production lines in 1997, a senior Plock official said on Thursday.
"Production will not be shut off this year even during the modernisation of our plant," Tadeusz Stoklosa, in charge of Plock's production told Reuters.
He said Plock was not operating at full capacity, which meant that the refinery could renovate one of its four distilleries without significantly curbing output.

Poland's second largest refinery in Gdansk on Wednesday said that it would shutdown for renovation from April 28 to June 22 and will import 500,000 tonnes of refined oil products to maintain its sales.
